svg.title: A landscape is several systems at once
svg.desc: Conceptual connections: energy powers water pumping; water supports generation, irrigation and habitats; farming affects runoff and habitat; habitats support pollination. Arrows identify relationships, not measured flows.
svg.text: A landscape is several systems at once
A conceptual map of relationships a coupled model could examine
Connections vary by place, technology and season. Arrow widths carry no quantities.
